items.exampleEn: Researchers are developing faster tests for pneumonia.
items.exampleZh: 研究人員正在開發更快速的肺炎檢測。

items.exampleEn: Horses can only breathe through their nostrils, not their mouths.
items.exampleZh: 馬只能用鼻孔呼吸，不能用嘴巴。

items.exampleEn: Sitting at the back of a bus makes my little brother want to vomit.
items.exampleZh: 坐在公車後段會讓我弟弟想吐。

items.exampleEn: Tuberculosis usually affects the lungs, but it can also affect other parts of the body.
items.exampleZh: 肺結核通常影響肺部，但也可能影響身體的其他部位。

items.exampleEn: Alcoholism is one of the topics covered in the public health course.
items.exampleZh: 酗酒是這門公共衛生課程涵蓋的主題之一。

items.exampleEn: Many scientists around the world are studying malaria.
items.exampleZh: 世界各地有許多科學家在研究瘧疾。

items.exampleEn: Snow blindness can happen when strong sunlight reflects off the snow.
items.exampleZh: 強烈的陽光從雪地反射時，可能會造成雪盲。

items.exampleEn: Doctors use special machines to monitor patients in a coma.
items.exampleZh: 腦科學家用特殊儀器研究昏迷中的病人。

items.sentenceEn: Thanks to clean water and better housing, tuberculosis became much less common.
items.sentenceZh: 多虧了乾淨的水和更好的住屋，肺結核變得少見多了。

items.audioEn: The boat trip was so rough that two passengers felt like they would vomit.
items.audioZh: 那趟船程非常顛簸，有兩位乘客覺得快要吐了。
items.questionZh: 為什麼有乘客覺得快要吐了？

items.sentenceEn: Pneumonia was one of the main topics at the science conference.
items.sentenceZh: 肺炎是那場科學研討會的主要議題之一。

items.sentenceEn: The smell of the old fish was so bad that I almost vomited.
items.sentenceZh: 那條放久的魚臭到我差點吐出來。

items.stemEn: Public health workers hand out mosquito nets to protect people from ____ in hot, wet regions.
items.stemZh: 公共衛生人員在炎熱潮濕的地區發放蚊帳，保護民眾免於瘧疾。

items.stemEn: Total ____ means that a person cannot see at all.

items.passageEn: Our history class studied how public health has changed over the past two hundred years. Long ago, tuberculosis and pneumonia spread quickly in crowded, dirty cities. In hot regions, malaria was a serious problem, and for a long time people did not know that mosquitoes carried it. Over time, clean water, better housing and new medicines made a huge difference. Governments also began campaigns about alcoholism and how it affects families. Our teacher explained that blindness caused by a lack of vitamins is now much rarer. Scientists today use DNA research to understand illnesses better. We ended the class by discussing how simple ideas, like washing hands, can protect millions of people.
items.passageZh: 我們歷史課研究了兩百年來公共衛生的變化。很久以前，肺結核和肺炎在擁擠骯髒的城市裡傳播得很快。在炎熱地區，瘧疾是個嚴重的問題，而且很長一段時間人們都不知道是蚊子傳播的。隨著時間過去，乾淨的水、更好的住屋和新藥帶來了巨大的改變。政府也開始推動關於酗酒及其對家庭影響的宣導。老師說明，因缺乏維生素造成的失明現在已少見得多。如今科學家利用 DNA 研究來更了解疾病。下課前，我們討論了像洗手這樣簡單的做法，如何能保護數百萬人。

questions.questionZh: 人們後來知道瘧疾是怎麼傳播的？
下課前大家討論了什麼？
options: 科學家如何研發新的藥
以前的城市為什麼很髒
簡單做法如何保護很多人

items.promptZh: 在這本小說裡，主角昏迷了三個月。
referenceEn: In this novel, the main character is in a coma for three months.
The hero of this novel stays in a coma for three months.
rubricZh: coma 指「昏迷」（例如 in a coma、stay in a coma）
可用現在式或過去式；「主角」可寫 the main character、the hero 等

items.promptZh: 在寒冷的早晨，那頭牛的鼻孔冒出白氣。
referenceEn: On a cold morning, white steam came out of the cow's nostrils.
Steam rose from the cow's nostrils in the cold morning air.
rubricZh: nostril 指「鼻孔」，這裡用複數（例如 the cow's nostrils 等）
「冒出白氣」可寫，例如 steam came out of、steam rose from 等
時態可用過去式或現在式
